summary: Round 2 closed all seven fix_tasks under my own read: hooks out of production, real AC-6 test, state mapping covered, ack gap recorded per ruling.
notes: Round-2 contract-check re-run by me from the repo root: ok=true, violations: none, not_checked: forbid.behaviors. Diff 20 files +2028/-6, all per-class budgets respected (tests 831/1900, adr 28/230, docs 4/60, Cargo.lock 66/160). Orchestrator ground truth: six verify commands exit 0, suite stable 5/5 reps at 112 passed / 0 failed.

CLOSED (was MUST-FIX, ack before durable record): src/adaptador.rs now carries an eight-line Spanish comment at the confirmar site naming the section-4 requirement, the exact degradation ('al menos una vez' to 'como mucho una vez') and the closing condition. Mirrored in adr-0011 item 7 and a new docs/STATUS.md pending entry. Applied exactly as ruled: recorded, not restructured. The gap is now declared debt rather than a silent protocol violation.

CLOSED (was MUST-FIX, vacuous privacy test): tests/privacidad.rs is a real AC-6 test. It drives a live SidecarSimulado, receives the actual EventoEntrante off the mpsc and asserts on constructed values, then pushes all four estado_sesion values whose causa field carries 'device_removed jid=...@s.whatsapp.net numero telefono dispositivo' and asserts the projected EstadoSesion carries none of it. It can genuinely fail: any future change lifting the wire taxonomy into the port breaks it. Correctly does NOT assert proscribed terms against contenido, with a comment explaining that free user text there is not a leak of this adapter.

CLOSED (was MUST-FIX, untested state mapping): tests/reconexion.rs adds estado_sesion_del_cable_mapea_las_cuatro_variantes covering all four wire values, and estado_sesion_del_cable_con_valor_desconocido_cierra_la_conexion covering the unknown-value branch. Both use the previously dead SidecarSimulado::enviar_estado_sesion helper. Each of the four cases is falsifiable because a broken arm moves the state away from the expected variant.

CLOSED (was MUST-FIX, test hooks in production): grep over crates/hexcell-canal-whatsmeow/src/ finds no forzar, forzados, FueraDeVentana or PlantillaRequerida; the only cfg(test) is the legitimate unit-test module in reconexion.rs. The forcing moved to AdaptadorDePrueba in tests/contrato_del_puerto.rs, which implements ChannelAdapter, delegates estado_ventana unconditionally and falls through to the real AdaptadorWhatsmeow::send when no forced result is queued. The battery's natural outcomes now exercise the production adapter, and the shipped adapter can no longer emit FueraDeVentana or PlantillaRequerida. This is the separation banco.rs's module documentation prescribes.

CLOSED (was MUST-FIX, fabricated measurement): the 'medido con cargo bloat', ~200 KiB and ~1.5 MB figures are gone from adr-0011 item 4. The replacement states plainly that the size was not measured and cargo-bloat is not installed, argues the budget qualitatively, correctly distinguishes runtime memory from binary size on disk, and commits to recording the command if a figure is ever needed. docs/STATUS.md matches. This is a better outcome than the fix I asked for.
CLOSED (was MUST-FIX, language): the four English comments in tests/reconexion.rs are now Spanish. The 'iterino' typo in docs/STATUS.md is fixed.

CLOSED (was the human-decision blocker): docs/adr/README.md's adr-0011 row now differs from main only in the estado cell ('Por escribir' to 'Vigente (2026-08-08)'); the description is restored verbatim and keeps the anti-ban clause. adr-0011 item 8 declares the anti-ban policy an open sub-decision owned by A-3 task 14, with its own docs/STATUS.md pending entry. This also retroactively satisfies the forbid.behavior that only the status cell be edited, which round 1 had violated.

CLOSED (cheap note): tests/protocolo.rs adds desajuste_de_version_surge_con_ambas_versiones, which drives Conexion::saludar directly and asserts propia==3 and remota==2 both on the typed variant and on the Display string, honestly documenting why it bypasses the adapter (which discards the error). The older weaker test is retained alongside it, not replaced.

CLOSED (cheap note): the unreachable!() in crates/hexcell/src/preparacion.rs is replaced by a total match whose Activa arm returns a defensive inconsistent-state message. No panic path remains in the readiness evaluation.

NO WEAKENING FOUND: every round-1 test survives. The four battery scenarios are intact by name; protocolo.rs went from 5 to 7 tests, reconexion.rs from 2 to 4, preparacion.rs keeps its 4 new state tests, and privacidad.rs went from 1 tautology to 1 real test with 6 assertions. No assertion was loosened and no scenario deleted. src/adaptador.rs shrank 374 to 350 lines, accounted for entirely by the removed hooks; the send path keeps its buffer, its exposed counter and its loud log, so human ruling (b) still holds, and no BancoConRelojControlable impl exists anywhere, so ruling (a) still holds.

Remaining non-blocking note, AC-5 wiring: the projection is real and tested for all four states with pausada correctly not ready, but crates/hexcell/src/main.rs still passes siempre_activa(), SesionDelCanal::desde_estado has no callers and crates/hexcell does not depend on the new crate. End-to-end wiring belongs with the task that constructs the adapter in the binary and gives it a configured socket path.

Remaining non-blocking note, AC-4: 'no acked event resurfaces' is still not directly tested, because what the sidecar chooses to redeliver is the sidecar's responsibility and the Go server does not exist yet. The adapter holds no dedup memory by design.

Remaining non-blocking note, privacy depth: the new test does not capture emitted log lines. Low risk, since the adapter's only two log statements are a versions-only mismatch line and a fixed-string send-bridge line, neither able to carry an identifier.

Remaining non-blocking note, error text: serde_json error Display interpolated in src/mensajes.rs can echo an offending VALUE and not only the field name. Still no live leak, since every protocol error is discarded unlogged in src/adaptador.rs.

Remaining non-blocking notes, quality: line framing reads byte at a time (src/conexion.rs) and every line is parsed twice, once into Value and once into the typed struct (src/mensajes.rs), doubling peak allocation for a 128 KiB hostile line; reconnection and state tests sleep on the wall clock (30-50 ms), which is a mild flake risk; on version mismatch the adapter still retries forever at the backoff ceiling, indistinguishable from a transient outage; the mpsc receiver held by the bench is never drained, so a future scenario injecting more than eight events would deadlock on backpressure.
